basic_details.job_title: Maharishi Valmiki Hospital Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 11 Posts

important_dates.interview_date: Every working Friday from 09-10-2026 to 30-10-2026 (10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for Senior Resident is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST, and 48 years for OBC (Delhi) Candidates, as on the date of interview.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior resident (adhoc): Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB/DIPLOMA equivalent) in concerned specialty. In case of non-availability of MD/MS/DNB/DIPLOMA Candidates, then Candidates who have at least 02 years Experience of Govt. Hospital/Govt. Institution in the concerned specialty will be considered for the post and will be appointed on purely Adhoc basis for 89 days.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 67700/- in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of 7th CPC & other allowances as admissible
salary_details.senior resident: Basic of Rs. 67700/- in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of 7th CPC & other allowances as admissible.

selection_process: Candidates who fulfill the eligibility criteria may appear for the interview panel on every working Friday from 09-10-2026 to 30-10-2026
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria for Senior Resident posts as outlined in the notification.
Prepare original certificates along with self-attested copies of all required documents.
Attend the walk-in interview at the Conference Hall, First Floor, Maharishi Valmiki Hospital, Pooth Khurd, Delhi-110039.
Report on any working Friday between 09-10-2026 and 30-10-2026 from 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon.
Submit your application along with self-attested copies of certificates at the time of interview.
important_instructions: Appointments are purely on an adhoc basis for a period of 89 days or till fresh/regular incumbents join, whichever is earlier. Candidates who have completed three years Senior Residency but are willing to serve as Senior Resident can also apply and will be offered residency only if no fresh Senior Residents are available, for a period of 89 days extendable up to a maximum period of one year only. The services of Adhoc SRs are likely to be terminated upon joining of Regular SRs through Govt. of NCT of Delhi or Regular interview of SRs even if the tenure of 89 days is not completed. No separate letter for interview will be issued. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. If candidates of a reserved category do not appear for interview, seats may be filled from other categories as per reservation policy.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at Maharishi Valmiki Hospital?
faq.answer: Maharishi Valmiki Hospital has invited applications for the post of Senior Resident on an adhoc basis across various departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies available for Senior Resident posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The selection is conducted through a walk-in interview. Candidates must appear in person with original documents.

faq.question: Q4. What are the walk-in interview dates?
faq.answer: Walk-in interviews are conducted on every working Friday from 09-10-2026 to 30-10-2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon.

faq.question: Q5. What is the venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is held at the Conference Hall, First Floor, Maharishi Valmiki Hospital, Pooth Khurd, Delhi-110039.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB/DIPLOMA equivalent) in the concerned specialty, or at least 02 years experience in a Govt. Hospital/Govt. Institution in the concerned specialty if MD/MS/DNB/DIPLOMA candidates are not available.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST, and 48 years for OBC (Delhi) candidates as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary provided?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a basic salary of Rs. 67700/- in Revised Pay Matrix 11 of 7th CPC and other allowances as admissible.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
